asm-boundary-marker.description: Scope boundary marker with an illustrative 0.2 m size. Downstream plant is outside the modeled scope.
asm-boundary-marker.source: Size: E1a fixture choice. Boundary role: docs/PUMP_SKID.md.

asm-check-valve-dimensions.description: Illustrative DN50 check valve: face-to-face length 0.18 m and body diameter 0.11 m. Its inlet-to-outlet direction follows process flow.
asm-check-valve-dimensions.source: Length: docs/PUMP_SKID.md prototype value. Body diameter: E1a fixture choice.

asm-dn50-pipe.description: All five process connections are DN50 with an assumed 0.0603 m outside diameter. This is not a selected pipe schedule or fabrication specification. Liquid service with unknown duty, flow, pressure, temperature, material, and wall thickness.

asm-guided-routes.description: Guided orthogonal centreline routes chosen once for the fixture, leaving and entering each nozzle along its axis: tank to suction valve (0.5, 0, 0.2) to (0.72, 0, 0.2); suction valve to pump (0.88, 0, 0.2) to (1.175, 0, 0.2); check valve to discharge valve (2.39, 0, 0.7) via (2.7, 0, 0.7) to (2.7, -0.37, 0.7); discharge valve to boundary (2.7, -0.53, 0.7) to (2.7, -0.75, 0.7). No fittings, supports, slope, or clash checks.

asm-indicator-dial.description: Conceptual level and pressure indications drawn with an illustrative 0.08 m dial. Not an instrument specification or hookup design.

asm-indicator-mounts.description: Conceptual indication mount points: level indication on the tank top centre (0, 0, 1.2); pressure indication on top of the pump discharge line at (1.9, 0, 0.73). No tapping, hookup, or support is modeled.

asm-isolation-valve-dimensions.description: Illustrative DN50 suction and discharge isolation valves: face-to-face length 0.16 m and body diameter 0.10 m.
asm-isolation-valve-dimensions.source: Length: docs/PUMP_SKID.md prototype value. Body diameter: E1a fixture choice.

asm-manual-route.description: Manually chosen pump discharge route: rises from the pump outlet (1.5, 0, 0.5) to (1.5, 0, 0.7), then runs along +x above the motor to the check valve inlet (2.21, 0, 0.7). Included to exercise preservation of manual routing.

asm-pump-dimensions.description: Illustrative centrifugal pump envelopes: body 0.45 m long (x) by 0.30 m wide (y) by 0.40 m high (z); motor 0.35 m long by 0.22 m diameter on the shaft axis. End suction and top discharge follow template centrifugal_pump version 1. Not a vendor selection.

asm-skid-layout.description: Illustrative skid arrangement. The deck top is z = 0 m; process flow runs along +x at y = 0 until the discharge turns toward -y. Placement origins use template version 1 local frames: tank shell base centre (0, 0, 0); suction valve centre (0.8, 0, 0.2); pump body base centre (1.5, 0, 0); check valve centre (2.3, 0, 0.7); discharge valve centre (2.7, -0.45, 0.7) and boundary marker centre (2.7, -0.85, 0.7), both rotated -90 degrees about z. Tank and pump nozzles project 0.10 m from their bodies. Not a plant layout, support, or access design.

asm-tank-dimensions.description: Illustrative vertical cylindrical tank: diameter 0.8 m and height 1.2 m. The outlet nozzle centreline is 0.2 m above the tank base, chosen to align with the pump suction centreline. Not a vessel design.
asm-tank-dimensions.source: Diameter and height: docs/PUMP_SKID.md prototype values. Outlet height: E1a fixture choice.

rcp-appearance.description: Colours, metalness and roughness are appearance-only. They assert no material of construction, coating or finish.

rcp-boundary.description: Scope boundary drawn as a flange and short pipe stub at the boundary port, included in CAD. The marker plate is display-only and excluded from CAD.

rcp-check-valve.description: Check valve drawn as a flanged body with a bolted top cover and a raised flow arrow from the inlet port toward the outlet port. Disc, seat and closure behavior are not modeled.

rcp-fasteners.description: Hex nuts with protruding stud ends mark bolted joints (casing cover, feet, bonnets, anchors). Sizes are illustrative; no bolt specification or torque is implied.

rcp-flange-dn50.description: Illustrative DN50 flange proportions on every process port: outside diameter 150 mm, thickness 18 mm, four 18 mm holes on a 120 mm bolt circle straddling the centrelines. Resembles common DN50 flanges; no pressure rating, facing or standard is selected.

rcp-indicator.description: Conceptual indication drawn as a generic dial (hex socket, stem, case and blank white face) at its assumed mount. No tapping, hookup, instrument type, range or reading is modeled.

rcp-isolation-valve.description: Isolation valve drawn as a flanged body with a bolted bonnet and a handwheel operator. A handwheel was chosen so that no open/closed position is implied. Valve type, trim and normal position remain unknown.

rcp-motor-details.description: Motor frame with end shields, 28 radial cooling fins (none at the bottom) and a domed fan cowl, drawn inside the motor_length x motor_diameter envelope. Terminal box (above) and feet (below) are illustrative additions outside that envelope. No power, speed, efficiency or enclosure rating is implied.

rcp-nozzle-neck.description: Equipment nozzle necks are 72 mm outside diameter with an illustrative 52 mm bore shown at the flange. Nozzle stubs keep the template lengths, and each flange joint face lies exactly on its template port.

rcp-pump-baseplate.description: Common baseplate under pump and motor: 25 mm (or 8 % of body height if less) thick, from the suction end of the body envelope to the motor end, body_width wide, resting on the deck at z = 0 with six anchor bolts. Not a foundation or grouting design.

rcp-pump-casing.description: End-suction pump casing drawn as a spiral volute with a top discharge neck, axial suction neck, suction cover, casing cover, bearing frame and cast feet, proportioned from body_length, body_width and body_height and kept inside that envelope. The volute lies in the plane of the template discharge port. Impeller, internal passages, seals, bearings and wall thicknesses are not modeled.

rcp-pump-drive.description: Exposed shaft, jaw-type flexible coupling and an open-bottom coupling guard with two legs, placed between the bearing frame and the motor inside the body envelope. No coupling rating or guarding standard is implied.

rcp-route-joints.description: Each current route end carries a weld-neck-style mating flange and four studs with nuts through the equipment flange. Gaskets are omitted.

rcp-route-pipe.description: Pipe drawn as a solid outside-diameter envelope (wall thickness unknown) swept along the route points, with bends of centreline radius 1.5 x DN (75 mm for DN50) reduced only where adjacent runs are too short. Bends replace the sharp polyline corners within the bend zone; endpoints are the exact route points.

rcp-tank-details.description: Vertical tank drawn as a closed envelope solid with a base ring, top rim, two circumferential seam bands, four anchor chairs and a nozzle reinforcing pad. Wall thickness, heads, internals and openings other than the modeled outlet are not modeled.

motor frame spans motor_length and reaches motor_diameter
casing reaches the suction face and body top
pump end stays inside the body envelope
